name: University of Warwick
feeMethod: Lists every course in an official overseas fee table (undergraduate courses sit in a few fee bands) and raises fees for continuing students with inflation; the calculator uses each course's own row.
description: The University of Warwick is a public research university founded in 1965, with its main campus on the southern edge of Coventry in the English Midlands. It is a member of the Russell Group and is known for economics, mathematics, business and computer science.
whyIncluded: Warwick publishes Singapore entry grades, such as AAA in three H2 subjects or a Singapore polytechnic diploma GPA of 3.4 to 3.8 depending on the course. Its medical and law degrees are both recognised for practice in Singapore (Singapore Medical Council and Singapore Institute of Legal Education lists).

livingCosts.summary: Warwick's own monthly living-cost figures for its students (groceries, transport, socialising, phone, clothes, health) plus a mid-priced en-suite room on campus for 2026/27 with bills included. The visa minimum is 1,171 a month outside London.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A (two Warwick pages). Food, transport and personal from Warwick Student Funding 'Living & Course Costs' ('Monthly Living Costs for a Student at Warwick University', Save the Student survey updated Oct 2025): groceries 153; transport 53; personal = socialising 129 + holidays/events 29 + clothes/shopping 35 + phone 15 + health/wellbeing 28 = 236. Housing from the Warwick Accommodation 'Accommodation list' (Campus Residences 2026, revised Aug 2026): undergraduate weekly rents run from 128 (Rootes, shared bathroom) to 255 (Bluebell, en suite); the median listed rent of GBP 215/week (Sherbourne en suite, 42-week contract) x 52/12 = 931.67; campus rent includes bills (the funding page's 49/month bills figure applies only to off-campus non-Warwick housing). Months = 10 (campus contracts are 40-42 weeks). Warwick's international 'Living costs' page gives only the Home Office figure of 1,171/month (9 months) and ~13,632 for a 12-month master's. Laundry (5.50 a load), parking, course materials (no amounts given) and one-off costs excluded.

programmes.notes: Warwick Student Finance 'Postgraduate Taught Fees' table (read 2026-10-15), row 'Accounting and Financial Management (MSc)' P-NN00, Full Time, Overseas: 2025-26 42,730, 2026-27 43,580 (used), 2027-28 44,500; Overseas tier because Singaporeans are international students. feeYear 2026 kept in line with Warwick's other master's rows. One-year programme; fees rise annually so cohortLocked false. No 2024 row: the 2024-25 version of the same table (Common Crawl capture, March 2024) has no Accounting and Financial Management row, only the predecessor 'Accounting and Finance (MSc)' P-N4N6 at 40,700, which is a different course code so not used.
